label: president or manager of
definition: Person X holds or held an explicitly identified president or manager office in organization, team or institution Y.
scope_notes: Preserves the earlier combined president/manager scope. Generic head, leadership, ownership, coach or ordinary employee alone does not establish these offices. Truncated personal-principal arguments may omit a campaign/organization and require review.

facts.reason: Mr. Lee is explicitly Taiwan president; generic lead alone would be weaker.
Lamoriello is explicitly Devils president in possessive and noun constructions.
Sather is explicitly Rangers manager and president.
Samaranch is explicitly I.O.C. president in three constructions; successor context is additional.
Skilling is explicitly Enron president in all three supplied rows.
